title: Israel elections: Can Netanyahu turn security gains into a political victory?
summary_full: Israeli voters will head to the polls on October 27 in a significant election for Benjamin Netanyahu. His political future hinges on addressing security failures following the October 7 attack by Hamas. Gadi Eisenkot has emerged as a primary challenger, emphasizing military accountability over Netanyahu's leadership. The election highlights divisions within the opposition and potential coalition challenges.
